overview_description.description:
Rewaa was founded to make penetrating through the e-commerce industry easier for retailers with minimal operational and marketing costs by solving two main aspects:
 
Marketing aspect: Make in-store products available online. By using Rewaa Cashier System, any product in the physical store will be automatically listed in the online marketplaces and the merchant's online store. 

Operational aspects: The integration between physical, online store and marketplace, eliminate the need of independent inventory for online store operations, and that will help to reduce employment cost, therefore, the physical store will be the shipping center, so whenever an order received by online store will be transferred automatically for the nearest branch from the customer. And eventually, the inventory will be automatically updated across all channels.

product.name: Rewaa ERP System
product.description: An enterprise resource planning system that manages financials, supply chain, and human resources with unified data and local compliance.

product.name: Rewaa Inventory and POS Platform
product.description: A platform for managing inventory and sales across online and offline channels with integrated POS and marketplace connections.

product.name: Rewaa Customer Relationship Management (CRM) System
product.description: A CRM system that records, analyzes, and manages customer data to improve marketing, sales, and customer service processes.

product.name: Rewaa Financial Management Module
product.description: A module within the ERP system that controls accounting, cash flow, asset tracking, and financial reporting.

product.name: Rewaa Supply Chain Management Module
product.description: A module that automates purchasing, supplier performance analysis, inventory monitoring, and product flow management.
